test_title: PYST 08: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that contains a spelling error.

options.text: They had been disgrantled with the company due to various reasons.
Despite his formidable appearance, he possesses a kind heart.
We saw a pride of lions nonchalantly roaming in the forest.
He has made significant improvement in the last few weeks.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"disgrantled" **is incorrect in option 1.
 
• The correct word should be **"disgruntled"** (असंतुष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **They had been disgruntled with the company due to various reasons.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Formidable** (भयावह): Inspiring fear or respect through being impressively large, powerful, intense, or capable.

 
 
• **Example: **Despite his formidable appearance, he possesses a kind heart.
 
 
 
• **Nonchalantly** (अनासक्त): In a casually calm and relaxed manner.
 
 
• **Example: **We saw a pride of lions nonchalantly roaming in the forest.
 
 
 
• **Significant** (महत्वपूर्ण): Sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention; noteworthy.
 
 
• **Example: **He has made significant improvement in the last few weeks.
